statement: Hill & Ridge Community Market is scheduled for 3 October 2026, 9am–2pm, at Red Hill Recreation Reserve; unsafe weather can cancel it without notice.
note: Corrected 23 September 2026 from the organiser homepage, which directly lists 3 October 2026, 9am–2pm, Red Hill Recreation Reserve, 184 Arthurs Seat Road. The prior migrated claim about 5 September described the season restart and is no longer the promoted event date. Weather may cancel without notice.
